critique.title: Self critique
items: White dominates; colour only appears for action, selection and state (buttons, active tab, correct/wrong badges).
No card grid; the test list is a lined DataTable.
Radii are hierarchical: controls 6px, panels 8px, dialog 12px.
No emoji, forbidden icons, all-caps labels or blended colour fills; Phosphor Light weight only.
Motion only answers a user action (button transition, tab/dialog opening); no decorative animation.
Copy is action-oriented and exclamation-free ("Save test", "This cannot be undone").
The rail collapses at 390px, every control is keyboard-reachable, and focus rings stay visible.
The ornament I removed: the first draft grew the shadow on button hover; docs/03 allows a single elevation level (floating layers only), so I dropped it.

free.q: Is the Free plan time limited?
free.a: No. The Free plan has no time limit; only the limits in the table apply.

cancel.q: Is my content deleted if I cancel?
cancel.a: No. Cancellation takes effect at the end of the paid period and you return to Free. Your tests, questions and files are not deleted; only creating new content follows the Free limits.

card.q: Do you store my card details?
card.a: No. Payment is taken on the payment provider's own page. Card details never pass through or stay on Testcim servers.

seats.q: Can I use it with my team?
seats.a: The Pro and Team plans include several seats. Seat counts are in the table.

trial.a: A Plus trial is granted with a coupon code. If you have one, enter it on the Plan and billing screen in Settings.

ai.q: Do AI questions go straight into the test?
ai.a: No. AI output always arrives as a draft and does not enter the test until you approve it.

changelog.title: Release notes
changelog.lead: Platform updates, new features and security hardening in Testcim.
items: Instant Ctrl+V capture pipeline and mobile camera capture with homography perspective warp
Rich question editor: KaTeX equation editor, geometry drawing canvas, and dynamic tables
PDF cropping studio with automated projection and text-layer splitting
Print-ready PDF, Word (DOCX) and PowerPoint (PPTX) multi-target export engine
Online exam delivery, live countdown timer and e-Okul compatible Excel/CSV export
Camera-based optical mark recognition (OMR) and grading engine
AI question generation, variation generator and step-by-step solver
Class roster import, student progress report cards and curriculum outcome analytics
Hardened RLS tenant isolation, cryptographic CSP nonce, and security mitigations
